# Fatoki Victor Oluwabusayo - Portfolio

This is the public portfolio website of Fatoki Victor Oluwabusayo, a Product (UI/UX) Designer and Business Strategist specializing in user research, design strategy, and product design.

## Core Pages
- **Homepage (`/`):** Hero introduction, work sliders, selected projects list, work experience, and contact forms.
- **About (`/about`):** Detailed background story, philosophy, design approach, and capabilities.
- **Resume (`/resume`):** Professional background, roles, skills, and strategic experiences.
- **Journals (`/journals`):** Collection of articles, case studies, thoughts, and lessons on product design and strategy.
- **Dynamic Projects (`/project/[slug]`):** Individual case study details including problem, strategy, outcome, and takeaways.

## Key APIs & Data Sources
- **Supabase Integration:** Dynamic content such as blogs and project details are fetched via Supabase SSR client.
- **Sitemap (`/sitemap.xml`):** Auto-generated dynamic list of all indexable pages.
- **Open Graph Image (`/opengraph-image.png`):** High-resolution preview image for social sharing cards.

## Metadata & Search
- Standardized SEO meta tags, Open Graph tags, and Twitter Card details are configured for optimal sharing previews.
